body.message:
Hi, I have a few belongings that I need some help moving. I have a few suitcases and some storage boxes, but I need a few boxes as well to pack everything properly.

I've booked a moving company to collect my things, but they're not being allowed to come inside the building and are only allowed to stay in the lobby. I'm not actually moving out of the apartment, so I don't have (or need) a move-out permit.

Would it be possible to help me with this? I only need to take a few suitcases and boxes downstairs so the movers can collect them.
